problem_statement: Create a browser-based report generator dashboard that connects to SQL database REST APIs and transforms raw query results into visual reports, packaged as a zero-backend React component with multiple analysis modes.
implementation_plan: Initialize project with minimal React setup and zero build requirements
Implement data fetching and state management hooks
Create sample datasets for users and products
Build four analysis modes (charts, statistics, tables, real-time)
Implement REST API configuration and bearer token authentication
Set up Jest + React Testing Library for testing
acceptance_criteria: Component works as standalone with zero backend dependency
Supports four distinct analysis modes with charts, statistics, and tables
Connects to configurable SQL database REST APIs
Includes sample datasets for users and products
